method: Instrument actual example loops with CPU clocks and GPU pass timestamps. Synthetic video; no camera permissions. Warmup frames excluded. Configurations run sequentially; model clock variation prevents interpreting total frame differences as presentation speedups.
warning: Do not attribute frame-minus-model time entirely to pre/post shaders: CPU handling, GPU copies, presentation, queue/browser scheduling and callback delivery also contribute. Forced detections include a small diagnostic setup dispatch in postprocessing.

results.timing: GPU timestamps on the actual three compute passes; CPU clocks for crop/upload calls, encoding and frame-fence completion. One additional timestamp readback alongside the existing frame fence adds profiling overhead. Medians are not additive because CPU and GPU work can overlap.
results.note: outsideComputeSpanWallMs includes crop, upload/conversion, presentation, queue scheduling and browser callback latency; it is not all postprocessing work.
